title: School that turns into a mall?
content: The dream started as me walking to my high school again with familiar friends and at first the school and streets are normal of what I would be used to in my hometown but when I get inside it’s a different school I’ve never been in before. As I’m dreaming I don’t know where I’m going but my dream body is just moving for me, it feels like my legs are on autopilot but my mind, soul and emotions felt really there. Im talking to two people I haven’t seen since elementary school kinda felt in a rush? The hallways and staircases were crowded so we weren’t alone. The friends I knew in real life went into different classes/rooms on different floors and as they each reach their desired room they each said their goodbyes. All the doorways inside the classrooms looked rly bright with a white glow. I finally reach a staircase of where I was suppose to be and I open the door and it’s the mall weird place again. The design and architecture of the mall is like late 90s but early 2000s vibe? I basically felt lost the whole time I was walking around the mall until I finally I arrive at an airport??? and I search for a exit door and as I exit the door I’m outside. It’s day time and sunny. I felt a weight lift off of me in my dream like that’s all I wanted in my dream was to be outside? I’m in some suburb I haven’t rly seen before walking down the side walk that has a busy ish street to one side of me and storefronts and businesses on the other side of me, my body turns in a different direction and I am walking down a street with houses and a Park and I decide to go to the park and it has a nice path with trees and grass. As I’m walking, I walk next to these two trees but I see two lawn chairs and two family members were sitting in them and I go up to them like omg hey guys where are we and they basically started walking with me and as we’re walking out of the park, I notice we’re surrounded by so many houses with long streets. It felt like my family members picked me up & threw me into a random streetblock and I landed on top of a roof? Then I woke up. So weird, I’ve been to this school/mall/airport/suburb place before so It felt so familiar.
